title: eludite.browser.open_external input
description: Open a url in the person's own browser, outside Eludite (the system's opener: `xdg-open` on Linux, `open` on macOS, `start` on Windows), for them to look at with their own sessions; default: the active tab's url. Does not wait for the browser and cannot read anything back: use the eludite.browser.* tools to look at pages yourself. Permission class execute; a `url` off the allowed origins (the solution policy's `browser.origins`) makes the call dangerous, which prompts (ADR-0009).
x-eludite-escalates: Dangerous when `url` is off the allowed origins (the solution policy's `browser.origins`).

url.description: An absolute URL with a scheme (`http://localhost:5000/`). Default: the active tab's url.
